title: Lamp Oil
summary: Pim Rushlight knows what burns, and the Sickpools' vats burn better than anything he sells. Hold eight waves out there, and he'll show your mages how to keep a fire off somebody (the mage's level-12 skill).

steps.journal: Hold eight waves in the Sickpools, among the old vats.

ready: Go back to Pim Rushlight, at his handcart by Saltmere's cistern.
done: Pim taught your mages Arcane Ward. He charged nothing, and told you so three times.
